# Knowledge index

44 active practices, 62 learnings. Load the least that answers the question:

1. `kb/bundles/<stack>.md`: one line per practice for a stack (`any` always applies).
2. `grep -i <term> kb/index.jsonl`: one JSON line per node, with edges.
3. `kb/practices/<id>.md`: the card, with the reason. Its `derived_from` names the evidence.

| Concern | Practices | Read before |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Testing | 8 | writing a test for a race, a browser flow or a flaky case; running a local stack or two suites |
| Data and concurrency | 4 | an ORM write, a counter, a claim, a hold, a cleanup job |
| Security | 7 | an auth or ownership check, anything sent to a client, a security probe |
| UI | 7 | a form field, a third-party widget, accessible names, restyling, many canvases |
| Git and CI | 9 | a push, a worktree, a CI failure or cost, a scanner version, a PR whose checks went missing |
| Agents and models | 9 | delegating to subagents or cheaper models, or planning new infrastructure |

## Must rules
- claim-shared-work-atomically: Claim shared work in one step.
- credential-is-not-authorization: A valid credential is not authorization.
- gate-push-on-exit-status: Push only after the gate's own exit status says green.
- names-are-private-data: In a public repo, names are private data.
- no-whole-row-writes: No whole-row writes from a stale read.
- one-client-payload-builder: One function builds every client payload, and it strips solutions for every type.

## Tools
- 21st (plugin): 21st.dev UI skills and MCP. Pinned upstream.
- actions-cost (skill): Estimate a change's GitHub Actions runner-minutes before merging it; on demand and cached over a prebuilt matrix.
- best-practices (skill): The curated practices, one topic file per concern, generated from kb/practices.
- caveman (plugin): Terse output mode. Pinned upstream.
- cheap-reviewer (agent): Read-only correctness and safety review of one commit or the working diff, on a mid-size model.
- claude-md-management (plugin): Audit CLAUDE.md quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.
- code-review (plugin): Pull request review with several specialized agents and confidence scoring to filter false positives.
- code-simplifier (plugin): Agent that simplifies recently modified code for clarity while preserving behavior.
- commit-commands (plugin): Slash commands for git commit workflows: commit, push, open a PR.
- context7 (plugin): MCP server for version-specific library documentation and code examples.
- deslopify (skill): Audit copy for AI-writing tells and fix them line by line.
- frogify (skill): Rewrite copy in frog's voice, marketing or editorial register.
- frontend-design (plugin): Distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces that avoid generic AI aesthetics.
- github (plugin): Official GitHub MCP server: issues, pull requests, code search, repository management.
- humanizer (skill): Rewrite prose at length to remove signs of AI writing. Vendored, MIT.
- issue-management (skill): Triage and restructure GitHub issue backlogs with one owner per outcome, clear stages and testable acceptance.
- learning-loop (skill): Capture a lesson, curate it into a practice, promote it, harvest inboxes, retire it.
- model-delegation (skill): Which model does which work, how to brief a cheaper agent, and how to check its work.
- netlify-cost (skill): Estimate a Netlify site's builds, credits, edge runs and bandwidth before changing its config; ignore script, complete gate.
- playwright (plugin): Browser automation MCP server by Microsoft: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, run end-to-end flows.
- ponytail (plugin): Minimal-solution mode. Pinned upstream.
- serena (plugin): Semantic code analysis MCP server: symbol-level navigation and refactoring via language servers.
- session-continuity (skill): Keep long work alive across compactions: durable state, standalone check-ins, work checked against the plan, open points raised.
- superpowers (plugin): Brainstorming, subagent-driven development with built-in review, systematic debugging, red/green TDD, and skill authoring.
- token-efficiency (skill): Fewer turns and tokens for the same work. Batch tool calls, keep context lean, wait in the background, save facts once.
- typescript-lsp (plugin): TypeScript and JavaScript language server for code intelligence.
- visual-loop (skill): Show design options on the real thing, read every screenshot first, loop until the user picks.
